title: Bát hát
about: Round x4 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi"): singing bowls rubbed slowly in the dark, wobbling, over a drone and a wind that comes and goes; meditative and still. C sharp minor at 46 bpm. An original piece.
